name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 29

clue.text: Fair beating is what soldiers expect

Music for listening to on one’s own
Work in some pain

Note the woman full of power!

Hit one over line

It’s very hard to keep you and me in — and quiet!
